2511-7084-8347.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

4289-4770-5295-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

803-5226-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
803-5226-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Lithatog ability, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

719-5686-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
719-5686-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat from step 3.

81-512-5475.easyPrerequisites:
Kami of Whispered Hopes and Forensic Researcher do not have summoning sickness.
Kami of Whispered Hopes has power 2 or greater.
81-512-5475.description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Forensic Researcher and Kami of Whispered Hopes, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
81-512-5475.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Kami of Whispered Hopes's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

618-3899-4142.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Hostage Taker.
When the Hostage Taker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the Hostage Taker token.
When the Hostage Taker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

301-2646-7861.description:
Activate Clickslither by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Resolve the Clickslither ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1879-3259-3699.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control a creature token.
1879-3259-3699.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Cadira, triggering Breath of Fury and Cadira.
Resolve the Cadira trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1739-2781-6867-7183.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

3457-6478-7791.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Arbor Adherent with toughness 2 or greater.
3457-6478-7791.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Arbor Adherent.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Arbor Adherent.
Repeat.

6719-6996-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
6719-6996-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

104-2999-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-2999-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-3033-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Vengeful Vampire
When Vengeful Vampire dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Vengeful Vampire
When Vengeful Vampire dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Carrion Feeder abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2438-3033-6972.notes: If Vengeful Vampire starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-6972-7511.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Witch-king
When Witch-king dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Witch-king enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Witch-king
When Witch-king dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Witch-king enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
413-6972-7511.notes: If Witch-king starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

222-2292-4871--73.easyPrerequisites:
The persist or undying creature doesn't have a -1/-1 or +1/+1 counter on it, respective to its ability.
You control a Saproling.
222-2292-4871--73.description:
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing the persist or undying creature and Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee and the other creature die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice and the other creature's persist or undying ability triggers.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the persist or undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 or +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the undying or persist creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and the persist or undying creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

7-4907-5256-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-4907-5256-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Hamza. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2769-3259-4460.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2769-3259-4460.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Hanweir Garrison as attackers.
Hanweir Garrison triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

2908-3682-4668-5542.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
2908-3682-4668-5542.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana.
Cast Dream Stalker by paying one mana.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers twice due to Delney, returning Mox Amber and Dream Stalker from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3129-4017-4050-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
3129-4017-4050-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color
Repeat from step 1.

2034-5671-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, The Necrobloom triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

586-1472-5626-6797.easyPrerequisites: You do not control a creature named Keimi.
586-1472-5626-6797.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
Tatsunari triggers, creating a 3/3 Keimi legendary creature token.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Keimi and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
Repeat.

372-2781-6966.description:
Cast All-Fates Stalker by paying its mana cost.
When All-Fates Stalker enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing Icewind Stalwart to return to the battlefield from exile.
When Icewind Stalwart enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking All-Fates Stalker.
All-Fates Stalker leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering All-Fates Stalker's first and second abilities.
Resolve the second All-Fates Stalker trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the All-Fates Stalker trigger from step 5, exiling Abdel Adrian until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2421-2510-3705-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee and Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Oracle of Mul Daya

907-4826-5449-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
907-4826-5449-5702.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary. When it enters untapped due to Archelos, Selesnya Sanctuary and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Oracle of Mul Daya.
Because of the additional Oracle of Mul Daya token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

requires.n: Vehicle with MV >= 3 and a Crew Ability

997-5747-6243--123.easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast the Vehicle with MV >= 3.
The number of artifacts you control is equal to or greater than the Vehicle's crew number minus 2.
997-5747-6243--123.description:
Cast the Vehicle by paying its mana cost.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Activate the Vehicle's crew ability by tapping the Construct, causing the Vehicle to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Vehicle.
When the Vehicle dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning the Vehicle from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not be an Angel because the Vehicle is no longer a creature and cannot gain creature types.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Rite of Passage

292-1495-3927.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage and Sakashima's Protege trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Triskelion.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.

222-527-5295-5686.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1339-1479-1671-6674.easyPrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have at least one additional card in hand.
1339-1479-1671-6674.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it, Kodama and Rydia trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Rydia trigger, causing you to rummage.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Rydia trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

3362-5241.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Sakashima's Student
3362-5241.description:
Cast Sakashima's Student by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Bladewing.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sakashima's Student's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Bladewing's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

1069-1251-5285-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
Luminarch Ascension has at least four quest counters on it.
1069-1251-5285-5499.description:
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Angel.
Activate the Angel by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Angels.

1090-2438-6132.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Restoration Angel.
1090-2438-6132.description:
Cast Restoration Angel by paying its mana cost.
When Restoration Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Restoration Angel.
Resolve the Restoration Angel ability, blinking Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Restoration Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2757-3327-5256.notablePrerequisites:
You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
You control a basic Mountain.
2757-3327-5256.description:
Activate a basic Mountain, adding {R}.
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Dargo, untapping a basic Mountain.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Dargo's power.
Repeat.

654-1018-1541-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Skullwinder, adding {R}.
When Skullwinder dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Skullwinder on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Hit the Mother Lode by paying {4}{R}{R}{R}, exiling Skullwinder from the top of your library and casting it without paying its mana cost, and creating seven tapped Treasure artifact tokens.
When Skullwinder and the Treasures enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers seven times and Skullwinder triggers once.
Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Hit the Mother Lode from your graveyard to your hand, and allowing an opponent to return a card from their graveyard to their hand.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

3199-3209-4485.notablePrerequisites:
Docent of Perfection can be transformed.
You have at least three opponents.
You control at least two untapped creatures, one of which must be green.
3199-3209-4485.description:
Activate Spellbinding Soprano's encore ability by paying {3}{R} and exiling it from your graveyard, creating a token copy of it with haste for each opponent you have.
Declare each Spellbinding Soprano token as an attacker.
Each Spellbinding Soprano token triggers, causing instant and sorcery spells you cast this turn to cost {1} less to cast for each Spellbinding Soprano token.
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by tapping a green creature and any other creature you control.
Docent of Perfection triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Wizard creature token.
Resolve Sprout Swarm, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token and returning Sprout Swarm to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.

1171-1653-1656-2335.notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
1171-1653-1656-2335.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Garth One-Eye's ability by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast a copy of Black Lotus.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Garth One-Eye's ability by tapping it, causing you to pay {1}{G} to cast a copy of Regrowth.
Resolve Regrowth, returning Garth One-Eye to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Tireless Tribe's ability by discarding Garth One-Eye, giving Necrotic Ooze +0/+4 until end of turn.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite {G}, you may sacrifice Black Lotus for any other color of mana, and use that to cast any other spells from Garth One-Eye's ability.

1434-3846-3851.notablePrerequisites:
Atemsis does not have summoning sickness.
Blade of Selves attached to Atemsis.
Opponents can not block and kill creatures you control.
You have at least six cards in hand with different mana values.
1434-3846-3851.description:
Declare Atemsis as an attacker.
Atemsis' myriad ability triggers, creating a token copy of Atemsis tapped and attacking each other opponent.
Deal combat damage using each Atemsis, triggering their abilities.
Resolve each Atemsis trigger, causing you to reveal your hand and causing each opponent to lose the game.

1938-4200-4598.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, blinking Glorious Protector.
Glorious Protector leaves and enters the battlefield, returning Icewind Stalwart from exile to the battlefield, and triggering both Icewind Stalwart and Glorious Protector's enters-the-battlefield abilities.
Resolve the Glorious Protector trigger, exiling Icewind Stalwart until Glorious Protector enters the battlefield.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart trigger, blinking Glorious Protector.
Repeat from step 2.

677-803-1872.description:
Activate Compsite Golem by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, casting Composite Golem from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3562-4013.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}{C}.
3562-4013.description:
Activate all mana producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Sky Hussar.
Sky Hussar enters the battlefield, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

1323-3181-5137.notablePrerequisites:
Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
You control up to two lands that can produce a total of at least {U}{U}.
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
1323-3181-5137.description:
Activate up to two lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Morphling.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Morphling's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Krosan Restorer.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Morphling's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Krosan Restorer's ability by tapping it, untapping up to two lands.
Activate up to two lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 5.

3263-3764-4050.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Pincher, adding one mana of any color.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
